workspaceExportNativeDescription: Cikakken ajiya na Leafen don motsa ko dawo da wannan wurin aiki. Wannan nau'in yana kiyaye tsarin Leafen da bayanan meta.
workspaceExportCurrentJob: Fitar da wurin aiki na yanzu
workspaceExportOmittedPages_one: An cire shafin rumbun bayanai guda {{count}} da aka raba muku daban, saboda ajiyar tana maido da rumbun bayanai gaba ɗaya. Fakitin Markdown & CSV da na HTML sun haɗa da shi.
workspaceExportOmittedPages_other: An cire shafukan rumbun bayanai guda {{count}} da aka raba muku daban, saboda ajiyar tana maido da rumbun bayanai gaba ɗaya. Fakitin Markdown & CSV da na HTML sun haɗa da su.
workspaceExportOmittedFiles_one: Fayil guda {{count}} yana kan zuwa ne ko an cire shi, don haka an bar shi. Sake fitarwa don haɗa abin da ya zo tun lokacin.
workspaceExportOmittedFiles_other: Fayiloli guda {{count}} suna kan zuwa ne ko an cire su, don haka an bar su. Sake fitarwa don haɗa abin da ya zo tun lokacin.
workspaceExportReconnecting: Uwar garke ba ta amsawa. Ci gaban fitarwa zai sake bayyana a nan da zarar ta dawo; babu abin da za ku yi.
couldntCreatePage: Ba a iya ƙirƙirar shafi ba
logOutNoEmailTitle: A fita daga asusu a wannan na'urar?
logOutNoEmailBody: Wannan asusun ba shi da imel, don haka sake shiga yana buƙatar wata na’ura da aka shiga da ita ko lambar da mai gudanarwa ya bayar. Kana iya ƙara imel ko passkey tukuna a Saiti → Asusu.
remoteSignOutUnresolved: An fita daga wannan na’ura, amma zaman sabar har yanzu a buɗe take. Sake gwadawa ko tuntuɓi mai gudanarwarka.
pendingSignOutTitle: A watsar da canje-canjen da ba a daidaita ba?
pendingSignOutCount: Canje-canje guda {{count}} da ba a daidaita ba
pendingSignOutDescription: Ana ajiye waɗannan canje-canje a wannan na'urar kawai. Ba za a iya dawo da su idan an watsar da su ba.
pendingSignOutReadFailedTitle: Ba a iya duba canje-canjen gida ba
pendingSignOutReadFailedDescription: Wataƙila an ajiye wasu canje-canje a wannan na'urar kawai. Soke don kiyaye su, ko kuma a bayyane a watsar da canje-canjen gida don fita.
outsideAddressCardBody: Kunna shi don yin amfani da Leafen daga wayoyi, wasu na'urori, ko manhajojin Claude da ChatGPT.
agentCardBody: Ka bar Claude Code ko Codex su yi amfani da Leafen a matsayin ƙwaƙwalwar ajiyarsu.
noRecents: Shafukan da aka buɗe kwanan nan suna fitowa a nan.
noSectionsToAdd: Kowane sashe yana kan gefen gefe
shortcutsFull: Tab ɗin yana ɗaukar gajerun hanyoyi har {{limit}}. Cire ɗaya da ba ka ƙara amfani da shi ba don ƙara wani.
viewsFull: Tab ɗin yana ɗaukar kallolin rumbun bayanai har {{limit}}. Cire ɗaya da ba ka ƙara amfani da shi ba don ƙara wani.
layoutTooLarge: Tsarin gefen gefe ya yi girma da yawa don a adana shi (32 KB). Cire gajerun hanyoyi ko tab ɗin da ba ka ƙara amfani da su ba.

profiles.plainAddressRefused: A nan Leafen yana haɗi ne kawai da amintaccen adireshi (https://). Shigar da adireshin https na sabar, ko a duba lambar QR, ko a buɗe hanyar gayyata da allon sabar yake nunawa.

connect.title: A bar {{host}} ya nuna wuraren aikinku?
connect.body: Shafukan Leafen a {{host}} za su jera wuraren aiki da manhajoji na {{account}} a wannan sabar a cikin mai sauya wurinsu — sunayensu da gumakansu, ko kai baƙo ne da ko akwai wani abu da ba a karanta ba. Ba za su iya karanta ko canza shafuka ba. Kuna iya soke wannan a Saituna → Asusun sabar.

openLink.title: Buɗe {{host}}?
openLink.body: Wannan hanyar haɗi tana buɗe sabar Leafen da wannan manhaja ba ta yi amfani da ita ba tukuna. Buɗe ta kawai idan ka amince da inda hanyar haɗin ta fito; za ka shiga can.
